en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a large European river city taken from an elevated hillside terrace with balustrades and a large statue in the foreground. Below are curving park paths and a riverside promenade with several early 20th‑century steamships. A chain suspension bridge crosses the river, and on the far bank stands a large neo‑Gothic parliament building with a tall dome. On the near hillside to the right is a sprawling palace complex with towers, and multiple church spires rise from the dense historic rooftops.
